description: SIMCom default QMI composition 1e0e:9001: SIM7100E, SIM7600 (E-H, G-H, ...) and other SIM7xxx/SIM8200 modules share it, so the model comes from AT+CGMM, never from the PID. Interfaces: DIAG 0, NMEA 1, AT 2 primary, 3 AT/PPP, 4 audio, 5 QMI (qmi_wwan with the DTR quirk; option leaves 5 and 6 alone). ModemManager's SIMCom plugin owns it (it disables QMI WDS PCO for this ID). Radio over AT is the SIMCom dialect: AT+CNMP mode, AT+CNBP bands, AT+CPSI? serving cell, whose field layout differs per RAT (parse the RAT first; a negative RSSI is not a band). SIM7600E-H: one SIM slot; USSD must be sent as raw text (a GSM7-packed code answers 'retry operation'). RNDIS (1e0e:9011) and MBIM (1e0e:9003) compositions are not this profile (simcom-sim7600-9011, simcom-sim7600-9003). No netifd-qmi fallback: on this composition OpenWrt's stock qmi protocol left the 802.3 netdev without DHCP (another modem manager 3.5.8 needs its own raw QMI protocol; profiles audit 2026-10-19).

hints.at_source: ModemManager 1.25.95 src/plugins/simtech/77-mm-simtech-port-types.rules (SIM7000/SIM7100/SIM7600: 00 QCDM, 01 GPS, 02 AT primary, 03 AT secondary, 04 audio); Linux 6.12 qmi_wwan.c QMI on interface 5, option.c reserves 5 and 6
